title: Notice to submit undertaking.

source.name: Chanakya National Law University, Patna, Bihar

text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
Chanakya National Law University
Nyaya Nagar, Mithapur,
Patna – 800001
Date: 23rd September 2026.
It is hereby notified that the Hon'ble Vice-Chancellor has permitted all the students of 1st
Semester of 5 Year LL.B. & 1st and 3rd Semester of 3 Year LL.B. programme who have a
shortage of attendance below 75 per cent to appear in the Mid-Semester Examination, 2026,
subject to the following conditions:
1. The student shall submit an undertaking stating that they shall attend all the remaining
classes during the semester and ensure that their attendance reaches the minimum
mandatory 75% by October 2026.
2. Failure to achieve 75% attendance by the stipulated period shall render the student
ineligible to appear in the End-Semester Examination, 2026.
Students concerned are required to submit the undertaking to the email id
attendance@cnlu.ac.in before 5.00 p.m.
By Order
Sd/-
Prof. (Dr.) S. P. Singh
Registrar
Chanakya National Law University, Patna.
